Proud of our outstanding team at the U.S. Embassy in Ankara for their work processing visas for Iran’s national football team on their road to the @FIFAWorldCup in the United States.

Sports transcends borders, and we look forward to welcoming competitors and fans from around the world. ⚽🇺🇸

BREAKING: Iran's World Cup players have been granted visas to enter the United States.

But they will not stay overnight in the US; they will be based in Mexico and then fly in for each game. This means that they will have to go through US immigration ON THE SAME DAY as the game.

That could prove to be a disaster…

Told @bbc that some voices in Iran fear that Trump just wants a deal to pacify the markets ahead of the midterms, but that he will restart the war after November.

I am unconvinced. If Trump had a military option, he would use it now to WIN the war and use that win for the midterms. 

But the bottom line is: He doesn't have a winning military option with Iran.
